(2) The site is requesting payment ($4.99) for a certificate after a free quiz, which is a common scam pattern. (3) The form requests sensitive PII including full name, address, date of birth, SSN, and full credit card details - far more information than necessary for a legitimate certificate. (4) The certificate appears to be auto-generated based on quiz performance with no verification process, raising questions about legitimacy. (5) No clear company information, privacy policy, or terms of service are visible. (6) The combination of free quiz + paid certificate + excessive PII collection is a classic phishing/scam pattern. This does not appear to be a legitimate, trustworthy service.
